# The case for open-weight models and why we can’t trust frontier labs
Coding is the gentlest way to take this dependency, since the output is a durable artifact you keep and can review, and it is the one use I would readily defend. Wiring a frontier model into the live request path is the opposite, a standing bet on all four of those variables at once. Open weights are the only architecture that keeps the thing you depend on auditable, forkable, and yours, wherever you run it. The rest of this piece is the case for moving the model back inside the boundary
